title.zh: 排列视图：改一个音符不再重画整片缩略图
title.en: Arrangement: one note edit no longer redraws every miniature

highlights.zh: 修复轨道缩略图的 key 含数组下标导致的整片重挂：真实作品实测，一次编辑的迷你节点被替换数由 816 降到 0，新增变更由 817 降到 27。
highlights.en: Fixes an index-bearing React key on track miniatures that made one note edit remount them all: measured on a real piece, replaced miniature nodes fell from 816 to 0 and churn from 817 to 27.

highlights.zh: key 改用音符自身身份。typecheck 0 错、排列相关判据 37/37；该修复的自动化判据仍待补（已如实标注）。
highlights.en: The key now uses the note's own identity. Typecheck is clean and the arrangement criteria are 37/37; an automated criterion for this fix is still to be written, and is stated as such.
